limitations: Only these four assigned pairs were reviewed. This is not full-round acceptance, and the immutable module input still marks the full manifest pending.

All SHA values are owner declarations. Static case JSON identity fields were read against the assigned input; no hash command, validator, test, build, application, SSH, SQL or runtime probe was executed.

UI/UX Pro Max SKILL.md and the fresh-worker contract were read statically. Its search program was not executed; observations use the skill's built-in hierarchy, readability, layout and feedback guidance.

Original candidate images were viewed at their native 618x824 logical dimensions; assigned references are 1236x1648 physical pixels at declared factor two. No contact sheet, old candidate, local crop, image processing or resized substitute was used.
The comparison is qualitative original-image inspection, not a new pixel metric. Mechanical PASS values are not the basis of visual acceptance.

Supplied actions are scripted section actions with pointer_events=0. Static images and existing action/state/log records do not qualify hidden hit regions, native input, physical hardware, e-ink refresh, persistence, Store mutation, future incognito policy or download completion.
Only the assigned new report was authored. Production, harness, plan, captured originals and existing reports were not modified.
